title: German ATTR Amyloidosis Registry
summary: In this registry data from patient history and test results which are assessed during the yearly routine appointments at the treating hospitals are collected without patient identifying characteristics (such as name or date of birth) for patients with transthyretin amyloidosis or patients with a genetic predisposition for the development of transthyretin amyloidosis. The analysis of these data shall help to better understand the course of the disease and treatment effects.

interventions.name: Observational group of data which are assesed in clinical routine in the context of ATTR amyloidosis in the treating center.
